description: A part without fit-critical features built with example-mk4s-petg-0.4 but validated without a fit profile: blocker (FIT.MISSING has nothing to ask for, so only FIT.PROCESS fails).

findings.fix: validate it with fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4`, the one it was built with, or build it again without a fit profile
findings.message: the part was built with fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4` but is validated without a fit profile

unchecked.reason: no printer or bed was given, so the part was not checked against a build volume; choose a printer (openbrick validate --printer, or the playground's printer menu) or give a bed (--bed WxDxH)
